title: Order the evaluation funnel
intro: Each tier filters for the next — and the loop feeds back. Put the funnel in order.
prompt: Drag into order, first stage on top.

steps.text: Auto-score with a metric (SigLIP) — discard the clear failures
LLM judge / rubric on the survivors — scores, reasoning, per-element checks
Human review of the shortlist — nuance, culture, safety
Feed the insights back into generation and refine

debrief: Cheap and automatic first, scarce and human last: SigLIP filters volume, the judge and rubric explain the survivors, and human judgment lands only on the shortlist. The step everyone forgets is the last one — the funnel is a loop, and what the evaluators learned becomes the next generation's prompt. Skip a tier and you either drown reviewers or ship unexamined output.
